findings.root_cause: The `id` attribute on the <button> element was renamed from `submit-btn` to `submit`, so the CSS ID selector `#submit-btn` no longer matches any element in the DOM.
findings.suggestion: Avoid coupling tests to `id` attributes, which are volatile and can be renamed without warning. Instead, (1) add a stable `data-testid="submit-btn"` attribute to the button in SubmitButton.tsx so tests are insulated from `id`/`className` churn, OR (2) rely on the button's semantic role and accessible name ("Submit"), which are already present in the ARIA snapshot and are inherently stable. The preferred Playwright locator is `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' })` — it requires no source changes and aligns with accessibility best practices. If a test-hook attribute is preferred for disambiguation, add `data-testid="submit-btn"` to the button element and use `page.getByTestId('submit-btn')`.
